chunks: 1775 - Al-Sadiq عليه السلام said to ʿAlī ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz:
"Shall I not inform you of the foundation of Islam, its branch, its summit, and its peak?" He said: "Yes."

He said: "Its foundation is salat (prayer), its branch is zakat (alms-tax), and its summit and peak are jihad in the way of Allah, Mighty and Majestic. Shall I not inform you of the gates of goodness? Sawm (fasting) is a shield from the Fire."

key_terms.أَبْوَابِ الْخَيْرِ: the gates or means of attaining goodness
key_terms.أَصْلِ الْإِسْلَامِ: the essential foundation and basis of Islam
key_terms.الزَّكَاةُ: zakat (alms-tax), described here as the branch of Islam
key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: salat (prayer), described here as the foundation of Islam
key_terms.الصَّوْمُ: sawm (fasting), a devotional act that protects a person
key_terms.الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ: jihad in the way of Allah, described as Islam’s summit and peak
key_terms.جُنَّةٌ مِنَ النَّارِ: a shield and protection from the Fire

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the foundation of Islam and the virtue of fasting?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a concise structure of Islam by identifying salat (prayer) as its foundation, zakat (alms-tax) as its branch, and jihad in the way of Allah as its summit. It also highlights sawm (fasting) as one of the gates of goodness and a protection from the Fire, emphasizing the central role of acts of worship in spiritual salvation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1775 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said to Ali ibn Abdul Aziz:

"Shall I not inform you about the foundation of Islam, its branch, its pinnacle, and its peak?"
He said: "Yes."

The Imam (as) said: "Its foundation is prayer, its branch is almsgiving, and its pinnacle and peak are striving in the way of Allah (swt), the Almighty. Shall I not inform you about the gateways to goodness? Fasting is a shield from the Fire."
